parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the API group.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The number of the page to return. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tag of objects that match the rule. You can specify multiple tags.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudapi describe-models --group-id 30e792398d6c4569b04c0e53a3494381 --model-name Test --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --model-id 123 --tag Value=value Key=key --api-version 2016-07-14 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloudapi DescribeModels --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key key --ModelName Test --PageSize 10 --PageNumber 1 --Tag.1.Value value --ModelId 123 --GroupId 30e792398d6c4569b04c0e53a3494381
